title: fee-schedules.json
description: One row per company and property type (property_type null = the company does not tie the fee to a property type). Every fee value is nullable; null means unknown or not published, never zero. Fee values may be a single number, a min/max range or plans (see common.schema.json feeValue).

management_pct.description: Management fee, normally pct_of_rent. Single number, range or plans.

flat_fee.description: Flat management fee, normally flat_usd per month or per unit per month.

other_fees.description: Additional published fees that do not fit the four fee fields (onboarding, standalone prices). Only fees the source states.

verification_status.description: verified_own_site: value re-checked against the company's own public page. company_submitted: supplied by the company, rendered as 'Provided by the company'.

notes.description: Caveats such as unconfirmed plan labels or a network-wide pricing page.

verification_method.description: agent_read: an automated agent or fetcher read the company's page and the value matched. human_compared: a person compared the value with the live page. Shown to visitors as 'Read on the company's site' versus 'Checked by a person'.

verified_by.description: Role or handle of the person who compared the value (no personal data beyond a handle). Required for human_compared.

human_verified_date.description: Date a person compared the value with the live page. Null unless verification_method is human_compared.

scope.description: columbus_specific (default): the page states these fees for Columbus or Ohio. network_wide: the pricing page covers many markets, not only Columbus. unconfirmed_mapping: plan labels are not confirmed next to the values. The last two display with a caveat and do not count toward the fee gates unless quality.json feeScopesCountingTowardGates lists them. Both require notes.
